basis: Observed desktop, portrait and landscape Discovery videos, telemetry and samples; progress targets are capture cues, not product semantics.

milestones.label: M01
milestones.observedChange: Floor slab lands on the drawn sheet; first assembly layer.

milestones.label: M02
milestones.observedChange: Structural walls drop into position while higher layers retain their relation.

milestones.label: M03
milestones.observedChange: Glazing slides into the same building shell.

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: External cladding panels close around the same openings.

milestones.label: M05
milestones.observedChange: Rafters settle over the same walls.

milestones.label: M06
milestones.observedChange: Roof panels complete the six-layer assembly.

milestones.label: M07
milestones.observedChange: Whole building reads as a closed volume in axonometric projection.

milestones.label: M08
milestones.observedChange: Long-lens axonometric view opens to eye-level perspective at the glazed porch; sliding door opens.

milestones.label: M09
milestones.observedChange: Camera passes the same glazed threshold and enters the dining room.

milestones.label: M10
milestones.observedChange: Walk reaches kitchen, lounge and stove.

milestones.label: M11
milestones.observedChange: Camera rises to the same building's mezzanine loft.

milestones.label: M12
milestones.observedChange: Final camera looks back across the long room from the loft/ridge.

reverseSemanticStates: No reverse-only semantic state identified in Discovery contact sheets; reverse path follows assembly and walk backwards. Reassess if semantic pass shows asymmetry.
